invariants.text: A task with a status of 'completed' cannot be changed to 'in_progress'.
A task's status must be one of 'pending', 'in_progress', or 'completed'.
All task status changes must be persisted through the repository implementation.
If a task does not exist, attempting to update its status must result in a failure.
Task.id must be an auto-incremented integer primary key with default value None
The CLI must not directly query or modify the SQLite database; all operations must go through the service layer.
The repository interface must define methods to create, read, update, and delete tasks.
The service layer must ensure that only valid task status transitions are permitted.
The service layer must reject any attempt to set a task status to 'pending' if the task is already 'completed'.
The service layer must validate that a task's status transition is valid before updating it in the repository.
When a task is marked as completed, its status must be updated to 'completed' and no further status changes are allowed.
